title: Finite GS bounds and an unresolved norm–trace candidate

proved_results.theorem: Every degree-two cover Y of y^64+y=x^65 over F4096 with at least 523264 rational points has l(G)<=37 for every divisor of degree<=1024.
proved_results.coding_consequence: Binary dimension<=444 for the stated ordinary AG-affine certificate.

proved_results.theorem: The specified F1024 first-GS quadratic intermediate has genus 65953 and 2095200 rational points; its ordinary degree-certified affine concatenations have binary dimension<=1010.
On the Hermitian curve y^1024+y=x^1025 over F_(2^20), C_L(D,(2^29+2^20)P_infinity) intersect F2^(2^30) has binary dimension exactly 81.

Every affine F4 three-space in F65536 has at most 40 points of each nonzero norm class. The full affine F4-linearized degree-64 norm-trace subcode has exact binary parameters [1073741824,80,535953408].
proved_results.proof_method: Complete exact finite certificate with symmetry coverage proof; independently recomputed with different keys and coset arithmetic.
proved_results.independent_review: accept; complete certificate independently recomputed and final proof note audited

open_candidate.construction: Evaluate Tr_(F65536/F2)(y*f(x)), deg f<=65, on Tr_(F65536/F4)(y)=Norm_(F65536/F4)(x).
open_candidate.missing_theorem: For every nonzero degree<=65 polynomial f over F65536, sum over x with f(x) in F4 of (-1)^Tr_(F4/F2)(f(x)*Norm_(F65536/F4)(x)) is at most 128.
open_candidate.generator_runtime_bound: O(n^4) deterministic bit operations; no search over codes.
open_candidate.limitations: Neither the elementary bound 260 nor checks of structured families establish the required bound 128. No new code record is submitted.
open_candidate.independent_review: accept proved parts; target distance incomplete
open_candidate.partial_distance_result: All nonzero affine F4-linearized polynomials c+a0*X+a1*X^4+a2*X^16+a3*X^64 satisfy S(f)<=112. General degree<=65 polynomials remain unresolved.
